title: Compile Dependents
summary: Check the units that depend on the one being edited now, instead of waiting for the automatic quiet-period pass (lint-tree tier 3)
intro: Read this when you have changed a unit and want to check the units that depend on it right away. It runs that check now instead of waiting for the automatic quiet-period pass.

steps: The units that depend on it are checked now instead of after the automatic quiet period

questions.ask: I changed a unit -- do the units that use it still compile?
